theorems.name: Submission.idtp_tdc_csfp_subspace_eq_of_inter_ball
theorems.statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (Q₁ Q₂ : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (x : Euclid P) (t : ℝ), x ∈ Q₁ → 0 < t → (Q₁ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x t = (Q₂ : Set (Euclid P)) ∩ ball x t → Q₁ = Q₂
